title: ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot returns from her first mission to the International Space Station
summary: ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot has arrived back in Europe, landing in Cologne, Germany, following her return to Earth with Crew-12 after 237 days, nearly eight months, aboard the International Space Station for her εpsilon mission.
